findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: is_this_settlement_letter_real · Private data: find_breach_settlement, breach_settlement_details, breach_settlements_no_proof_needed, is_this_settlement_letter_real, settlement_claim_deadline, how_much_will_i_get_from_settlement, how_to_file_breach_claim · Public sink: is_this_settlement_letter_real.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: is_this_settlement_letter_real · Private data: find_breach_settlement, breach_settlement_details, breach_settlements_no_proof_needed, is_this_settlement_letter_real, settlement_claim_deadline, how_much_will_i_get_from_settlement, how_to_file_breach_claim · Public sink: is_this_settlement_letter_real

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
